In a star-studded segment, George Clooney hands over the microphone to Korean actor Park Bo-gum, speed skater Erin Jackson, and model Colman Domingo. The event, set against a vibrant red backdrop featuring the OMEGA logo, highlights the brand's connection with international sports champions and cultural icons.
